info.name: Sitecore CDP REST Audit Guest Data Extensions API

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

items.docs: Retrieves all custom data extensions associated with a guest profile. Data extensions are named sets of key-value pairs that store additional structured information beyond the standard guest attributes.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

items.docs: Creates a new named data extension on a guest profile. Each extension is identified by a unique name and contains a set of key-value pairs. Only one data extension of each name is supported per guest.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: dataExtensionName
params.description: The name of the data extension

items.docs: Retrieves a specific named data extension for a guest profile. Returns all key-value pairs stored within the extension.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: dataExtensionName
params.description: The name of the data extension

items.docs: Performs a full replacement of a guest data extension. All existing key-value pairs are replaced with those provided in the request body.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: dataExtensionName
params.description: The name of the data extension

items.docs: Performs a partial update of a guest data extension. Only the key-value pairs included in the request are updated; existing pairs not mentioned are retained.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: dataExtensionName
params.description: The name of the data extension

items.docs: Permanently deletes a named data extension from a guest profile. All key-value pairs within the extension are removed.
